evaluation_target.rationale: The safety goal explicitly states that the system shall prevent unintended braking, and the hazard defines the undesired event as the vehicle suddenly stopping without an obstacle in front.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: Vehicle braking behavior in straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h in good weather with no visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Operational situations matching the hazard description: straight ahead drive on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, good weather, and no visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The hazard provides the operational situation in which unintended braking is relevant and observable as a braking event occurring despite the absence of a visible obstacle ahead.

distinctions.dimension: Braking state relative to the driving situation
distinctions.contrast_a: Vehicle is braking or has suddenly stopped without an obstacle in front.
distinctions.contrast_b: Vehicle continues driving without unintended braking in the same road situation.
distinctions.rationale: The evaluation target depends on distinguishing whether unintended braking occurs at all in the stated operational situation; collapsing these cases would remove the ability to determine whether the hazard has occurred.

distinctions.dimension: Presence of a visible obstacle or vehicle ahead
distinctions.contrast_a: No visible obstacle or vehicle is in front of the ego vehicle.
distinctions.contrast_b: An obstacle or vehicle is visible in front of the ego vehicle.
distinctions.rationale: The hazard definition contrasts stopping with no obstacle in front against collision-avoidance braking. Distinguishing these cases is necessary to evaluate whether braking is intended or unintended.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether the vehicle is in an unintended braking state versus not braking in the relevant operational situation.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must allow the braking state to be distinguished as braking/sudden stop versus no unintended braking.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether a visible obstacle or vehicle is present in front of the ego vehicle versus absent.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must keep the presence/absence of a forward obstacle or vehicle distinguishable.
